children.title: Curiosity-Driven Learning and Autonomous Problem Formulation

detail.title: Curiosity-Driven Learning and Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.summary: Curiosity-driven learning and intrinsic motivation provide formal mechanisms that enable artificial agents and organisms to formulate, evaluate, and prioritize tasks when external rewards are sparse or deceptive.
detail.reason: Sufficient collected source evidence is now available to synthesize a provisional notebook addressing autonomous problem formulation.
